title: Chrome autofill and card data
whyItMatters: Stores names, addresses, phone numbers, email addresses and saved payment cards typed into web forms. It is a ready-made profile of the person behind the browser.
source: Chromium user data directory docs, profile files include Web Data: https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/main/docs/user_data_dir.md
notes: One Web Data file per profile. Card numbers are encrypted with the Windows account; addresses and autofill values are stored as readable text.

cleanup.exportFirst: Copy down any saved addresses or payment details you still need, because Chrome has no export for autofill data.
steps: In Chrome, remove saved addresses and payment methods from Settings > Autofill and passwords.
Delete the web data file named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Loses saved names, addresses, phone numbers and payment cards used to fill web forms in Chrome on this PC.
cleanup.source: Google Chrome Help, Delete browsing data in Chrome: https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/95582
